title: Homology of the derived unit on a shifted injective resolution
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes, $q\in\mathbf N$, $F$ an abelian etale sheaf on $X$, and $I$ an injective resolution of $F$. Use [def-weil-pbc-raw-restricted-normalization-data], [def-weil-pbc-abelian-higher-image-class] and [lem-weil-pbc-raw-restricted-resolution-cocycle]. Write $R=f_*$, $J=I[q]$, $K=R(I)$ and $H=H^0$ on the bounded-below derived category of abelian etale sheaves on $S$. Let $Q$ be localization of bounded-below complexes, $\nu_J:Q(RJ)\to R^+(QJ)$ the right-derived unit, $a:F[0][q]\xrightarrow{\sim}QJ$ the prescribed shifted augmentation, and $\lambda_J:H(Q(RJ))\xrightarrow{\sim}H^0(RJ)$ the quotient-homology comparison. Let $\sigma:H(R^+(F[0][q]))\xrightarrow{\sim}H^q(R^+(F[0]))$ be abelianComparisonShift. Let $r_I:R^qR(F)\xrightarrow{\sim}H^q(K)$ be isoRightDerivedObjCochainComplex and $h_F:H^q(R^+(F[0]))\xrightarrow{\sim}R^qR(F)$ be homologyRightDerivedFunctorPlusObjSingleFunctorIso. Finally let $s:H^0(R(I[q]))\xrightarrow{\sim}H^q(K)$ be $H^0$ of the termwise commShift comparison followed by the homology shift. Then, as sheaf morphisms, $\lambda_J^{-1}\gg H(\nu_J)\gg H(R^+(a^{-1}))\gg\sigma=s\gg r_I^{-1}\gg h_F^{-1}$. No etale chart, generator, chain map, or sheafification occurs in this identity. The right-hand composite is the directly constructed morphism of [def-weil-pbc-resolution-cocycle-homology-tail].

proof.text: Work with an arbitrary additive functor R throughout the calculation, and specialize to the direct-image functor only at the end. Apply resolution_homology_transport to the unshifted injective resolution. Cancel the extension-of-complex comparison against isoRightDerivedObjCochainComplex, and invert the resulting equality of isomorphisms. This identifies the unshifted unit followed by the inverse augmentation on homology with the inverse of the two classical derived-functor comparisons.

proof.text: Equip the bounded-below quotient and termwise functor with their commutation with shifts, using their faithful inclusions into the ambient categories. Construct the natural transformation from Q(R(-)) to R+(Q(-)) induced by the right-derived unit. Its components are the prescribed unit components, and its compatibility with shifts follows from commShift_rightDerivedFunctorPlusUnit and the canonical quotient comparison.

proof.text: Compare the prescribed shifted augmentation with the shift of resolutionAugmentationIso after applying the fully faithful inclusion into the ambient derived category. Transport the unit along this identity and the naturality square for the shift. The homology shift comparison for the bounded-below quotient is the ambient localization comparison, so its naturality turns degree zero of the shifted complex into degree q of the unshifted complex.

proof.text: Apply homology to the shifted unit identity. Substitute the unshifted inverse comparison from the first step. The remaining leading composite is exactly the termwise shift followed by the homology shift in resolutionCocycleHomologyTail, giving the claimed equality. All calculations apply without a positivity assumption on q, hence include q = 0 and the zero sheaf.

lean.statement:
theorem resolution_shifted_unit_homology {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (q : ℕ) (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (I : InjectiveResolution F) :
    let R := lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f
    let J := normalizationShiftedResolution F I q
    let H := DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor
      (Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) 0
    (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctorObjQIso (R.mapCochainComplexPlus.obj J) 0).inv ≫
        H.map (R.rightDerivedFunctorPlusUnit.app ((HomotopyCategory.Plus.quotient _).obj J)) ≫
        H.map (R.rightDerivedFunctorPlus.map (normalizationShiftedAugmentation F I q).inv) ≫
        (abelianComparisonShift f q F).hom =
      resolutionCocycleHomologyTail f q F I
